title: LymeHibry
description: No questlines. Just you, rich biomes, and revamped structures. Lightweight adventure for 1.21.1 !
body:
# LymeHibry Modpack
## English
A lightweight vanilla-plus modpack built purely for exploration, designed for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric).

## Core Gameplay
There are no quest lines, forced progression or complicated mechanics.
You are free to wander, discover new biomes and explore reworked structures at your own pace. This pack focuses on restoring and enriching the adventure experience of vanilla Minecraft.

## World Content
- Diverse and abundant biomes to explore across Overworld, Nether and End
- Fully revamped structures from YUNG's mods, including dungeons, mineshafts, strongholds and more
- All content is carefully balanced for natural exploration

## Mod & Performance
This pack contains **fewer than 100 mods** in total.
We adopt classic performance mods to keep high frame rates and low resource usage, even on regular devices.
It also includes practical quality-of-life mods, minimap, item tips and inventory tweaks to improve your gaming experience.

## Technical Notes
- Required on both Client and Server to run normally
- Shader compatible
- Recommended RAM: 3GB or above

Enjoy your journey in this refreshed Minecraft world!

## 简体中文
# LymeHibry 整合包
这是一款专为探索打造的轻量原版增强整合包，适配 Minecraft 1.21.1（Fabric 模组加载器）。

### 核心玩法
本整合包**没有任务线、强制流程与复杂机制**。
你可以自由漫游，随心探索全新群系与重制建筑，回归我的世界纯粹的冒险乐趣。

### 世界内容
- 主世界、下界、末地均新增大量风格各异的生物群系
- 搭载 YUNG 系列模组，全面翻新地牢、废弃矿井、要塞等各类建筑
- 所有内容经过平衡调整，游玩体验自然舒适

### 模组与性能
整合包总计**模组数量少于100个**。
内置多款主流优化模组，低配设备也能保持高帧率、低资源占用；
同时配备小地图、物品提示、便捷背包等实用功能模组，提升游玩体验。

### 运行说明
- 客户端与服务端**必须同时安装本整合包**才可正常联机
- 支持光影模组
- 推荐运行内存：3GB 及以上

祝你开启愉快的冒险之旅！
